item_name: ITW Nexus Plastic Grimloc MOLLE Locking D-Ring
item_short_desc: Easily mount gear onto your MOLLE vest, tactical backpack, or duffel bag at the push of a button with the Berry Compliant ITW Grimlock MOLLE Locking D-ring.
description: Easily mount gear onto your MOLLE vest, tactical backpack, or duffel bag at the push of a button with the Berry Compliant ITW Grimlock MOLLE Locking D-ring. This durable American-made accessory mounts onto any 1-inch webbing to add a place to secure light cargo like gloves, military helmets, first aid kits, and more. It is also great for adding a hydration pack to MOLLE tactical vests for convenient access to water for hikers, soldiers, and tactical professionals. The D-ring is made from reliable materials with a textured grip for stress-free use while wearing gloves or with wet hands. The tactical accessory is resistant to solar heat for use in the hot sun and has a breakaway feature to prevent potential snag hazards. Plus, this tactical essential is made with the cloaking benefits of GhilleTEX™ IR Signature Reduction Technology.
